g1-implement.title: Readiness core module + tests: implement
g1-implement.imperative: Fill IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF for G1. Build a PURE-over-DataFrame readiness core (proposed src/physics/layer2/regime_readiness.py) that, given the five-view estimate-store DataFrame, computes per regime-vector component {slow_corner_grip=lateral_mech_grip_g, fast_corner_grip=lateral_aero_grip_g, straight_line=(max_power_w,power_drag_area_m2), braking=(brake_decel_ms2,brake_aero_decel_per_m), traction=(traction_accel_ms2,traction_aero_accel_per_m); coast minor} the four readiness metrics: (1) SEPARABILITY — car-vs-car via fit_two_way frac_team (compose pooling.fit_two_way / pool_driver), AND param-vs-param via the off-diagonal correlation of the real 2x2 covariance blobs (braking_covariance etc.); (2) COVERAGE — per-constructor valid-round fraction (fit_status='ok', finite, σ finite/positive) out of rounds present; (3) CROSS-SESSION STABILITY — random-effects τ² (pooling.pool_random_effects) vs median within-σ, drift-aware (fit_drift) so real development isn't read as instability; (4) COVARIANCE HONESTY — cross-session standardized residual about the drift/RE pooled mean (z = (x_i-μ_pool)/sqrt(σ_i²+τ²)); report calibration as std(z) and the fraction within 1σ. Return a typed result object per component (metrics + a per-axis pass/fail against injectable thresholds, threshold defaults as a named constant). Honest covariance first-class. NO evo import. Tests must NOT read data/ — use synthetic in-memory DataFrame fixtures with known frac_team / τ / z so metrics are analytically checkable (L1) plus degenerate cases (single session, all-error, zero-variance → L3). Dispatch constellation-implementer. Integrate the IMPLEMENTER_RESULT.

g4-implement.title: Static-latent separability (manageable-uncertainty): implement
g4-implement.imperative: Fill IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF for G4. Extend src/physics/layer2/regime_readiness.py with a static-latent separability readout: per component axis, for each constructor pool its per-session values into a STATIC estimate (RE pool_random_effects -> mu_c +/- sigma_mu_c, with development drift separated via fit_drift), then measure CAR separability relative to the static estimate's OWN uncertainty (separation_ratio = between-car SD of mu_c / median sigma_mu_c; plus an F = var(mu_c)/mean(sigma_mu_c^2)). This is the pooling-thesis test the additive frac_team under-tested. Add a 'manageable' flag vs an injectable threshold (default separation_ratio>=2.0). Return per-car (mu_c, sigma_mu_c) so the ordering is visible. Pure-over-DataFrame; tests data/-independent. Dispatch constellation-implementer; integrate.
